methodology.population: phase11 markets where is_analysis_eligible is true
methodology.normalization: cross-sectional percentile rank from 0 to 100 within eligible population

variables.label: Tamaño del mercado
variables.rationale: Larger observed demand increases commercial scale.

variables.label: Frecuencia de ítems
variables.rationale: More items provide more observed purchasing events.

variables.label: Diversidad de compradores
variables.rationale: More public buyers reduce dependence on one entity.

variables.label: Ticket promedio por ítem
variables.rationale: Larger average transactions may justify acquisition effort.

variables.label: Apertura relativa
variables.rationale: Lower monetary concentration reduces observed incumbent dominance.

excluded_variables.reason: Governed UBIGEO dimension is not loaded.
Sanctions source is not ingested and is not an opportunity variable.

limitations: Single source period; growth and recurrence are excluded.
Relative score within 87 eligible markets; it is not comparable to another score version without recalibration.
The score does not estimate sales, win probability or return.
Weights express a documented business preference and remain scenario-sensitive.
